import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

class DL_Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super(DL_Model, self).__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(1, 16, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(16, 16, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        self.conv3 = nn.Conv1d(16, 1, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        self.flatten = nn.Flatten()
        self.linear = nn.Linear(16, 10)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = F.relu(self.conv1(x))
        x = F.relu(self.conv2(x))
        x = F.relu(self.conv3(x))
        x = self.flatten(x.view(x.size(0), -1))
        x = self.linear(x)
        return x


if __name__ == "__main__":

    input_tensor = torch.randn(1, 1, 28, 28)  # Example input shape: Batch size, Channels, Height, Width
    output_tensor = model(input_tensor)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

class DL_Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super(DL_Model, self).__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(in_channels='mask', out_channels='mask', kernel_size='mask', stride='mask', padding='mask')
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(16, 16, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        self.conv3 = nn.Conv1d(16, 1, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        self.flatten = nn.Flatten()
        self.linear = nn.Linear(16, 10)

    def forward(self, x):
        # the initial shape of x is: (1, 1, 28, 28)
        x = F.relu(self.conv1(x))
        x = F.relu(self.conv2(x))
        x = F.relu(self.conv3(x))
        x = self.flatten(x.view(x.size(0), -1))
        x = self.linear(x)
        return x


if __name__ == "__main__":
    model = DL_Model()
    input_tensor = torch.randn(1, 1, 28, 28)  # Example input shape: Batch size, Channels, Height, Width
    output_tensor = model(input_tensor)
    print(output_tensor.shape)
